scramble: R' F2 B L2 F2 D2 F2 D2 L F R' D B' U D' B2 R2 U F2 U'

stages.name: Cross
stages.moves: L' D2 F D' R' B D

items.text: No white edges solved: white-green FR, white-blue UF, white-red UL, white-orange BL. L' D2 F, D' R', B D builds the cross.

stages.name: F2L 1
stages.moves: y2 U' y' U2 R' U' R U' R' U R

items.text: Blue-red pair, both on top: corner UBR white up, edge UL, goes to BL. y2, U', then the fastest alg.

items.query: pair "F=green R=orange" "UBR: U white, B blue, R red" "UL: U red, L blue"
items.out:
This pair belongs in the BL slot (as the cube is held now); y2 brings it to the front right.
In that frame: corner UFL white facing U, edge UR front colour facing R.
F2L case 22 (Corner Point Up), after U' first.
Algorithms (y2 first, then do U' first, then one of these; the hands' time with every move's way back to the grip):
  y2 U' y' U2 R' U' R U' R' U R    ~30.2 s
  y2 U' F' L' U2 L F    ~38.2 s
  y2 U' U2 F' U' F U' F' U F    ~48.9 s

stages.name: F2L 2
stages.moves: U y' R' U' R U R' U' R

items.text: Orange-blue: corner in its FR slot with white on F, edge at UR. Basic case, and this alg is my fastest.

items.query: pair "F=orange R=blue" "DFR: D blue, F white, R orange" "UR: U blue, R orange"
items.out:
This pair belongs in the FR slot (as the cube is held now).
In that frame: corner DFR white facing F, edge UR front colour facing R.
F2L case 29 (Corner Bottom & Edge Top), after U first.
Algorithms (do U first, then one of these; the hands' time with every move's way back to the grip):
  U y' R' U' R U R' U' R    ~27.1 s
  U R' F R F' U R U' R'    ~36.1 s
  U F' U' F U F' U' F    ~45.8 s

stages.name: F2L 3
stages.moves: R U R' y' U R U' R'

items.text: Green-red pair is built but stuck in FR, the wrong slot. R U R' pulls it out, then y' U R U' R'.

items.query: pair "F=green R=orange" "UFL: U red, F green, L white" "UF: U red, F green"
items.out:
This pair belongs in the FL slot (as the cube is held now); y' brings it to the front right.
In that frame: corner UFR white facing F, edge UR front colour facing U.
F2L case 1 (Basics).
Algorithms (y' first, then one of these; the hands' time with every move's way back to the grip):
  y' U R U' R'    ~10.1 s
  y' R' F R F'    ~23.1 s

stages.name: F2L 4
stages.moves: y U' U' R U' R' U' R U2 R'

items.text: Last pair, green-orange: corner UFR with white on F, edge already in BR and oriented. y, then case 33.

items.query: pair "F=red R=green" "UFR: U green, F white, R orange" "BR: B orange, R green"
items.out:
This pair belongs in the BR slot (as the cube is held now); y brings it to the front right.
In that frame: corner UFL white facing L, edge FR front colour facing F.
F2L case 33 (Corner Top & Edge Middle), after U' first.
Algorithms (y first, then do U' first, then one of these; the hands' time with every move's way back to the grip):
  y U' U' R U' R' U' R U2 R'    ~22.4 s
  y U' U' R U' R' U2 R U' R'    ~22.4 s

stages.name: OLL
stages.moves: U R U R' U R U' R' U R U2 R'

items.text: Cross is done, corner yellows face sideways, headlights front and back: H, OLL 21. U puts them left-right, then the alg.

items.out:
OLL 21 (OCLL). The pattern this case's algorithms expect (top view, front at the bottom; Y = yellow, . = not yellow):
    . . .      (B side)
Y   . Y .   Y
.   Y Y Y   .
Y   . Y .   Y
    . . .      (F side)
Algorithms (from this exact pattern; the hands' time with every move's way back to the grip):
  R U R' U R U' R' U R U2 R'    ~30.2 s
  y R U2 R' U' R U R' U' R U' R'    ~39.8 s

stages.name: PLL
stages.moves: U' R' U R' U' R D' R' D R' U D' R2 U' R2 D R2 U

items.text: No headlights, a 2×2×1 block at UBL, diagonal corner swap, UF-UR edge swap: V perm. U' to set up, alg, then U.

items.out:
PLL V (Opp Swap). The pattern this case's algorithms expect (top view, front at the bottom; colours as on the solved cube):
    G O B      (B side)
O   Y Y Y   O
R   Y Y Y   B
R   Y Y Y   R
    G G B      (F side)
Algorithms (from this exact pattern; the hands' time with every move's way back to the grip):
  R' U R' U' R D' R' D R' U D' R2 U' R2 D R2    ~61.1 s
  R' U R U' R' f' U' R U2 R' U' R U' R' f R    ~63.2 s
